rationale: The source says selected input-space coverage can quantify coverage and expose gaps, while explicitly saying its relation to model performance is not yet clear. The claim therefore correctly refuses to treat a selected coverage metric as performance or a probability of safe operation.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-002-R1, Assured Autonomy through Combinatorial Methods, PDF p. 3
S-EVID-002-R2, Assured Autonomy through Combinatorial Methods, PDF p. 5
limitations: Chosen variables, discretization, and interaction strength govern the result; omitted factors can defeat apparent coverage.
It is a method paper, not a DAA result, regulator method, or safety-probability proof.
